profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); pro-accountability policing (low confidence)
summary: Manila 5th District representative with 31 principal-authored bills. Authored a universal social pension, expanded electricity lifeline rate, higher salary grades for government doctors, a ban on loan co-maker requirements, deposit-insurance expansion, bank anti-corruption transparency, digital-payment regulation, a Development Bank charter, body-worn cameras for law enforcement and prison-work rehabilitation.
caveat: Bill-list evidence only. Bank-transparency bills are one issue and are not scored for democratic institutions.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal social pension (-3), expanded electricity lifeline rate (-2), higher entry salary grade for government doctors (-2) and a ban on co-maker requirements in lending (-2). Development Bank charter mildly statist. Four issues, bill-based.
